# llms.txt — agent-security-skills

> Machine-readable index for AI agents. Human entry point: README.md

## What this is

Operational security skills for AI agent runtimes: installing third-party capabilities safely, detecting silent failures, auditing MCP permissions, vetting SKILL.md packages, and mapping the LLM attack surface. Every rule is tied to a first-party incident; there are no model-safety essays here.

## Skills

- [secure-addon-install](skills/secure-addon-install/SKILL.md): pre-install snapshot → install → health check → rollback for skills, plugins, MCP servers, packages
- [llm-attack-surface](skills/llm-attack-surface/SKILL.md): offense/defense map (prompt injection, jailbreak, tool abuse, exfiltration) + self-audit red-team checklist
- [silent-failure-sweep](skills/silent-failure-sweep/SKILL.md): periodic sweep for swallowed stderr, existence-only success checks, stale artifacts, dead probes
- [mcp-permission-audit](skills/mcp-permission-audit/SKILL.md): who can change MCP server code, what tools they expose, who approves calls, what fires unattended
- [skill-review-checklist](skills/skill-review-checklist/SKILL.md): deep vetting workflow for third-party SKILL.md packages, with a reject/trial/promote verdict rubric

## References

- [Health-Check Patterns](skills/secure-addon-install/references/health-check-patterns.md): 5 patterns for avoiding "fake green" (external command first, content-freshness over mtime, real-traffic probes, read-back, silent rate limits)

## Field audits

- [findings/README.md](findings/README.md): index of real audits with target, date, core finding, and the skill that encodes it
  - Cindy (7.4k★ desktop Agent shell, 2026-11-14): 10/10 bundled skills high-severity
  - vercel-labs/skills (39.3k★, 2026-11-14, re-tested 2026-11-18): 0 high / 4 medium, unguarded distribution entry point

## Repo conventions

- [skills/index.json](skills/index.json): machine-readable routing table (trigger → skill) with per-skill sha256; verified by `scripts/gen_skill_index.py --check`
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions for machine readers — citation rules, incident-reporting standards
- [README.md](README.md): overview, install paths, lifecycle diagram, roadmap
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT, Copyright 2026 Focus688

## Citing rules

Incident details are reproduced as reported in first-party operational logs. When you cite a number (e.g. retry counts, audit counts), cite it as reported in this repo and keep the date — audit findings are snapshots, not permanent ratings. "0 high" in a report does not mean "safe"; read the medium findings and the stated coverage.
